title: test(console): wait for the lazy route to settle in the API console route-table cases (objectui#10645)
body:
Fixes #10645
Clause-②: no

Test-only. Session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy` (domain:ui seat 5 dispatch, claim comment 5835159185).

## What changed

- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx`: a readiness helper `lazyRouteSettled()` waits, under a named bound `LAZY_ROUTE_BOUND_MS = 10_000`, until neither loading frame of the lazy route is in the document: the boot screen (`LoadingScreen`, text read from `en.console.initializing`) and the registry key's "Loading API console…" fallback. The three API-console route-table cases call it after `renderConsoleAt(...)` and before their existing `findByPlaceholderText`. Every existing assertion is unchanged. No retry, no skip, no source change.
- `.changeset/10645-api-console-preset-lazy-route-readiness.md`: empty frontmatter (releases nothing). See "Deviation" below.

## Mechanism, measured (base `0c3f70a`, shared box, through `os-verify-lock`)

Timeline probe (throwaway harness: a MutationObserver plus a `vi.mock('react')` that wraps `lazy` to log when each factory is called and settles; deleted, never committed):

- The standalone `developer/api-console` case: `systemRoutes`' `ApiConsolePage` lazy is called at +3.5 ms and settles at +12.3 ms (the module is already in the ESM cache), the boot screen is committed at +12.2 ms, and the page appears only at +350 ms. That gap is react-dom 19.2.8's retry throttle (`FALLBACK_THROTTLE_MS = 300`, applied to a retry-lanes-only commit after a fallback). So H1's throttle attribution is now observed, not inferred.
- The throttle OVERLAPS the import instead of adding to it. With every lazy slowed by 900 ms, the base standalone case still passes (947 ms). It misses the 1000 ms window only once the import alone nears 1000 ms. That falsifies the thread's "about 690 ms left" reading.
- The CI DOM dump (job 108098969809) is `LoadingScreen` inside the `RouteFader` div, which is the `systemRoutes` `Suspense` fallback. "Connecting to data source" is that screen's first step label, and the harness already reports `getConnectionState: 'connected'`, so there is no boot connection to resolve in the harness.

## Sibling cases (H3)

- "the tool preview's link reaches the API console pre-filled…": **same shape, and more exposed.** It is the first case to route through the registry key, so it pays two lazies in sequence: app-shell's `ComponentNavView`, then `registerDeveloperComponents`' `ApiConsolePage`. Under a uniform slowed import, the base file fails this case first (at 900 ms). It now awaits readiness.
- "the developer:api-console registry key honours the preset": warm only because of file order, since it runs after the tool-preview case. At 1200 ms it fails on base as well. It shares the `it.each` body, so it gets the same wait. Where the lazies are already resolved, the wait passes on its first check.
- "harness control: an app-less URL reaches the root catch-all…": renders no lazy (root catch-all). Not the same shape, left alone.

## Why this form (H2), on the four axes

- (a) warm in `beforeAll`: rejected. AGENTS.md §测试纪律 says 「不要用 beforeAll 预热」: `hookTimeout` (10 s) is narrower than the 15 s `testTimeout`, and a hook miss fails as "failed file + 0 failed tests". The dispatch's option (a) conflicts with the repo rule, and I followed the repo rule.
- (b) as worded (`waitForElementToBeRemoved` on the boot screen): it throws when the element is absent at its first check. That is exactly the state of a row whose lazies are already resolved (the registry-key row in file order has no boot frame), and it does not cover the registry key's second frame. So I used (b'): a wait for the frames' absence, then the existing `findBy`.
- Real need: a required shard is red on three PRs that do not touch this file. Long-term: readiness is named, test-only, and consistent with AGENTS.md. AI-error resistance: the bound and the frames are named constants with their reasons, and a copy of the pattern cannot silently drop a frame without going red under the harness below (the harness itself is not committed). No scope growth: one file plus a declaration, no new gate.
- Honest limit: this is still a bounded wait, 10x wider and named for what it waits on. The unbounded import cannot move into the import phase without a module-scope render or a source change that exports the lazies. Both are out of this card's rulings.

## Proof

Slowed-import reproduction. The same harness makes every `React.lazy` settle N ms late and is injected into a byte-copy of the base file and of the patched file. Exit codes:

| delay | base file | patched file |
|---|---|---|
| 900 ms | exit 1 (1 failed: tool-preview 1036 ms) | exit 0 (tool-preview 1896, registry 45, standalone 945 ms) |
| 1200 ms | exit 1 (3 failed: tool-preview, registry, standalone) | exit 0 (2471 / 28 / 1225 ms) |
| 3000 ms | exit 1 (3 failed) | exit 0 (6091 / 47 / 3034 ms) |

Ablation, through `ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed file (anchor hit 1 time, blob changed, restored blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), at 1200 ms:
- A1, drop the "Loading API console…" frame: exit 1, tool-preview case red (2257 ms).
- A2, drop the boot-screen frame: exit 1, 3 cases red.

So neither frame is vacuous.

Timing: 10 separate `vitest run` processes per tree, whole file, shared box. Durations as min / median / max in ms:

| case | base `0c3f70a` | patched `a1d3064` |
|---|---|---|
| standalone route (the cold case) | 307 / 314.5 / 342 | 319 / 326.5 / 445 |
| tool-preview link | 58 / 67 / 82 | 77 / 90 / 100 |
| registry key | 34 / 35.5 / 41 | 43 / 49 / 64 |

Base passed 10 of 10 and the patched file passed 10 of 10 (`12 passed (12)` every run). The fix does not make the cold case faster, because the throttle floor stays. It moves that cost out of the 1000 ms `findBy` window.

## Gates

On the final head `095128f` (after merging `origin/main` `4758b33`):
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/developer/`: `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 68 passed (68)`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations`: all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: all exit 0.

Before the merge (the test file is byte-identical after it):
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0, after building the `@object-ui/console^...` closure. `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` lists this test file.
- eslint on the file: exit 0, 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:changeset-claims`: all exit 0.

## Deviation

The claim scoped the file surface to the test file, with "no changeset owed". `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` disagreed. With the test file alone it exited 1: "1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset". The script's header states it has no carve-out for test files under `src/`, and an empty frontmatter is its declared no-release answer. The os-dev role file makes that gate's verdict authoritative, so I added the empty-frontmatter changeset. The seat may drop it if it rules otherwise.

## Acceptance notes

- Not measured: why CI missed the window on the standalone case rather than on the tool-preview case. A uniform slow import predicts the opposite order. One candidate is starvation of the throttle's timer on a saturated runner, but I did not probe it.
- The existing comment above the module-scope `ApiConsolePage` import is true but incomplete: the factories do settle at once, but the first render still suspends and the reveal is throttled. The new helper's doc carries the remainder. I did not edit that comment. Carrier: none.
- AGENTS.md §测试纪律's module-scope-import prescription does not cover React 19's retry throttle on a lazy route. This is an observation on a governed file. Carrier: none, and not filed.
